title: Von Braun transmitted speech to Carol Rosin via mind interface

tellings.quote: It was for him to transmit to her a speech he wanted to give to a big conference.

plain: Steven Greer, a doctor who campaigns for governments to reveal what they know about aliens, tells a story about the rocket scientist Wernher von Braun and his former spokesperson Carol Rosin in the 1970s. Greer says Rosin told him that von Braun used a kind of mind-to-mind connection to pass her a speech he wanted given at a big conference. If true, it would mean von Braun had access to unusual mental technology.
